How did dinosaurs eat?

Scientists study fossil teeth to work out what a dinosaur ate. Sharp, curved teeth with jagged edges belonged to meat-eaters, because those teeth could slice through flesh.

Plant-eaters

Many plant-eating dinosaurs had flat or leaf-shaped teeth, which let them strip and grind tough plants.
